description: Fork of exp462: out_proj 4x output-scatter sparsity AND 4x tph (1024->4096). out_proj now = 4096 narrow tables (each writes E/4=16 outputs scattered into E=64). Param- and write-bandwidth-MATCHED to exp453's dense out_proj (25.2M, each out dim assembled from ~1024 tables), but structured as 4096 narrow output-specialized tables vs 1024 wide ones; cost = 4x more lookups/token. Tests whether more, narrower, output-specialized tables match/beat fewer wide tables at equal params. Baselines: exp453 dense 1.4967, exp462 (4x sparse, tph=1024) ~+0.013. Saves checkpoint.
